underspecified_points.hole: The task-specific primary scorer, contract predicates, guardrail predicates, paired-effect estimator, and simultaneous-bound procedure are named but not operationally defined.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must publish the scorer callable and direction, the exact contract and guardrail predicates with missing-value behavior, the paired resampling unit, the confidence-bound procedure, and the membership and correction rule for each error family; the implementation can then load these choices through the frozen manifest interface.

underspecified_points.hole: The frozen rule for choosing T_star from multiple surviving candidates has no objective or total tie-break.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must choose and preregister a total ordering, such as smallest retained SCC count followed by largest discovery margin and then lexicographic atom identifiers, and justify which ordering matches the irreducibility claim.

underspecified_points.hole: Direct outputs from ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE may not carry the source spans, executable regions, and contract roles required by the identical atom gate.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must define a baseline-neutral normalization policy and decide whether an output that cannot be deterministically mapped to the four-way atom schema is rejected, counted as an abstention, or excluded under a preregistered applicability rule.

underspecified_points.hole: The sampling frame for new paper-task pairs and the external reference used to label a false admission are unspecified.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must define the eligible paper-task population, selection or sampling rule, exclusion criteria, and an outcome-independent reference procedure that labels an admitted slice false; these choices must be frozen before any held-out pair is run.

enriched_steps.what_changes: Create a canonical JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) manifest with `task_cases` rows containing `case_id`, immutable input and expected-artifact references, and normalized weight; `branches` entries for F and B; versioned primary and guardrail scorer callables; contract-role predicates; plain-language threshold records for the minimum full effect, slice-to-full equivalence, and each guardrail; error-family allocations; the maximum registered-test count; parser and executor digests; and disjoint eligibility, discovery, and confirmation seed identifiers. Define an `inference_spec` interface that receives paired case/seed rows and returns the full-effect estimate, one-sided bound, slice-to-full interval, and corrected predicate decisions. 【author decision: fix the scorer direction and aggregation, contract and guardrail predicates, missing-value policy, paired resampling unit, simultaneous-bound procedure, and error-family membership; these choices control every admission decision.】 Serialize with sorted keys, normalized paths and numeric formats, hash the manifest plus every referenced immutable file with Secure Hash Algorithm 256-bit (SHA-256), and reject execution when any digest or required field differs.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Write one canonical JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) file before any run. Give every task case a stable identifier, immutable input and expected-output references, and a weight; identify the complete artifact F and same-scaffold baseline B; pin the versions of all scorers, contract checks, guardrail checks, parsers, and the executor; record the plain-language decision thresholds and error-allocation rules; and list separate random-seed identifiers for eligibility, discovery, and confirmation. Define one inference interface that converts paired case-and-seed rows into the full-effect estimate, its one-sided bound, the slice-to-full interval, and corrected pass/fail decisions. 【author decision: specify scorer direction and aggregation, every contract and guardrail predicate, missing-value behavior, the paired resampling unit, the simultaneous-bound method, and which decisions share each error family.】 Sort the JSON keys, normalize paths and numbers, hash the file and all referenced files with Secure Hash Algorithm 256-bit (SHA-256), and stop if any digest changes.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在任何运行之前写出一份规范化的 JavaScript Object Notation(JSON) 清单。为每个任务样例分配稳定标识，记录不可变的输入引用、预期产物引用和权重；标明完整产物 F 与同脚手架基线 B；固定全部评分器、契约检查、防护规则、解析器和执行器的版本；用文字记录判定阈值与错误率分配规则；并分别列出资格、发现和确认阶段的随机种子标识。定义统一的统计接口，把按任务样例和随机种子配对的记录转换为完整产物效应估计、单侧下界、切片相对完整产物的区间以及校正后的通过或失败结果。【作者需决定：明确评分方向与汇总方式、每项契约和防护规则的谓词、缺失值处理、配对重采样单位、同时置信界方法，以及哪些判定属于同一错误率检验族。】按键排序并规范化路径和数值格式，再用安全散列算法 256 位(Secure Hash Algorithm 256-bit, SHA-256)散列清单及其引用的全部不可变文件；任何摘要变化或必填字段缺失都应停止执行。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Materialize one paired-run table from the sealed eligibility identifiers, with one `pair_id` for each task-case/seed combination and two branch rows distinguished only by `branch_id` F or B. Reset mutable state before each branch, feed byte-identical case inputs and the same seed assignment through the frozen scaffold, and capture the artifact digest, raw scorer input and output, normalized primary score, each contract predicate result, each guardrail result, execution status, and stderr digest. Join F and B only on `pair_id`; reject duplicate, missing, retried-without-registration, or digest-mismatched rows. Emit an append-only outcome ledger plus a completeness summary that proves every registered pair has exactly one valid row per branch.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For every sealed eligibility random seed and task case, create one pair identifier and run two isolated branches: the complete artifact F and the same-scaffold baseline B. Reset mutable state between branches and give both branches exactly the same case input and seed. Save the artifact digest, the raw and normalized scorer results, every contract result, every guardrail result, execution status, and an error-log digest. Match rows only by the pair identifier, reject missing or duplicate branch rows and unregistered retries, and produce an append-only ledger showing that every pair has one valid F row and one valid B row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对每个封存的资格阶段随机种子与任务样例组合生成唯一 `pair_id`，并分别运行完整产物 F 和同脚手架基线 B 两个隔离分支。每次运行前重置可变状态，确保两个分支接收完全相同的任务输入和随机种子。记录产物摘要、评分器原始输入与输出、规范化主分数、每项契约结果、每项防护规则结果、执行状态和错误日志摘要。只按 `pair_id` 配对，拒绝缺失行、重复行、未登记重试或摘要不一致，并输出只追加的结果账本，证明每个组合恰好有一条有效 F 记录和一条有效 B 记录。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For each valid `pair_id`, form the primary-score difference F minus B using the manifest-declared score direction, retain its task-case weight, and pass the paired vector to the frozen `inference_spec`. This step first introduces Δ_τ(F) as the weighted paired full-artifact effect and L_F as its simultaneous one-sided lower confidence bound; it also introduces δ_min as the preregistered minimum benefit. Admit F only when L_F is strictly greater than δ_min and every required contract and guardrail predicate is true under its frozen correction rule. Emit an `eligible_F` record containing the manifest hash, ledger hash, estimate, bound, threshold, predicate decisions, and evidence row identifiers; otherwise emit `no_validated_beneficial_effect` with the failed condition and no candidate-generation state.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Within each pair identifier, subtract the baseline B score from the complete-artifact F score in the direction declared by the scorer and keep the task-case weight. Send all paired differences to the frozen inference procedure. This produces the full-artifact task effect Δ_τ(F), its simultaneous one-sided lower confidence bound L_F, and the preregistered minimum benefit δ_min. Continue only when L_F is strictly above δ_min and every corrected contract and guardrail check passes. Store the manifest and ledger hashes, the estimate and bound, the threshold, all predicate decisions, and the supporting row identifiers; otherwise return `no_validated_beneficial_effect` and do not create slice candidates.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在每个 `pair_id` 内，按照评分器预先声明的方向，用完整产物 F 的分数减去基线 B 的分数，并保留任务样例权重，再把全部配对差值交给冻结的统计过程。此处首次得到完整产物的任务效应 Δ_τ(F)、其同时单侧下置信界 L_F，以及预注册最小收益 δ_min。只有 L_F 严格高于 δ_min，且全部经过校正的契约与防护规则都通过，才允许继续。输出记录应包含清单摘要、账本摘要、效应估计、下界、阈值、全部谓词判定及其证据行标识；否则返回 `no_validated_beneficial_effect`，且不创建任何切片候选。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Parse the pinned SKILL.md into ordered leaf blocks using only explicit document nodes: heading-bounded sections, list items, fenced executable blocks, and tool-template records. Represent each `source_map` entry as a file digest plus byte and line half-open intervals, and each executable region as a pinned file digest plus symbol or template identifier and exact interval. Intersect a leaf with these records and a single manifest-defined contract role; emit an atom only when all four members resolve uniquely. Store each atom as `{atom_id, workflow_step_id, source_span, executable_region, contract_role, ordinal, component_digests}`, where `atom_id` is the SHA-256 digest of the canonical tuple. Split only where an explicit document or executable boundary occurs, never merge semantically similar leaves, preserve source order, and emit `ambiguous_atomization` with candidate matches whenever any member is absent or non-unique.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Parse the pinned SKILL.md by explicit structure only: heading-delimited leaf sections, list items, fenced executable blocks, and tool-template records. Describe each `source_map` span by file digest and exact byte and line intervals, and describe each executable region by pinned file digest, symbol or template identifier, and exact interval. Combine one workflow leaf, one uniquely intersecting source span, one uniquely intersecting executable region, and one contract role into an ordered atom. Give the atom a digest-derived identifier and store all four parts, source order, and component digests. Split only at explicit boundaries, never merge units because their meanings look similar, and return `ambiguous_atomization` with the competing matches if any part is missing or non-unique.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 只依据显式结构解析固定版本的 SKILL.md：标题限定的叶级小节、列表项、围栏代码块和工具模板记录。每个 `source_map` 区段用文件摘要、精确字节区间和行区间表示；每个可执行区域用固定文件摘要、符号或模板标识及精确区间表示。把一个工作流叶节点、唯一相交的来源区段、唯一相交的可执行区域和一个契约角色组合成有序原子。原子标识由规范四元组的 SHA-256 摘要生成，并保存四个组成部分、来源顺序和各组件摘要。只能在显式文档或可执行边界处分割，不能因为语义相似而合并；任一组成部分缺失或不唯一时，返回 `ambiguous_atomization` 及全部冲突匹配。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Create one vertex per frozen atom and derive candidate prerequisite edges from three executor-visible sources: declared prerequisite identifiers, references from an atom to an artifact produced by another atom, and executor dependency events captured during a full-artifact trace. Interpret u→v as 'u cannot execute correctly unless v's declared output and side effects are present.' Validate each candidate edge by replaying u from the same frozen pre-state twice, once with v available and once with v plus its uniquely attributable outputs masked while all other prerequisites remain fixed; retain the edge only when the executor requests v, loses a required input, or fails a declared contract in the masked replay. Record the evidence type and replay digests on every edge, reject self-edges, collapse duplicate evidence onto one edge, validate that every observed dependency has a represented producer, and abstain when masking cannot isolate v or an unowned hidden-state dependency appears.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Make one graph vertex for every frozen atom. Propose a dependency edge from procedure u to procedure v when u declares v as a prerequisite, reads an artifact produced by v, or the frozen executor reports that dependency while running the complete artifact. The edge u→v means u cannot run correctly without v's output or uniquely attributable state change. Check the edge by replaying u from the same saved pre-state with v present and with only v and its attributable outputs hidden, while keeping every other prerequisite fixed. Keep the edge only if the second replay requests v, loses a required input, or fails a declared contract. Save the evidence and replay digests, combine duplicate evidence, and abstain if v cannot be isolated or an observed dependency has no represented producer.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 为每个冻结原子建立一个图节点。若过程 u 显式声明需要过程 v、读取 v 产生的产物，或冻结执行器在运行完整产物时报告该依赖，就提出一条候选边。u→v 表示缺少 v 的输出或可唯一归因于 v 的状态变化时，u 无法正确执行。用同一份保存的执行前状态重放 u：一次保留 v，另一次只屏蔽 v 及其可归因输出，同时固定其他全部前置条件。只有屏蔽后执行器请求 v、缺少必需输入或违反已声明契约时才保留该边。为每条边保存证据类型与两次重放摘要，合并重复证据；若无法单独隔离 v，或观测到的依赖没有对应生产者，则弃权。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Run Tarjan's algorithm on G to compute Strongly Connected Components (SCCs), assign each component a stable identifier from its sorted atom identifiers, and construct condensation graph D by replacing every cross-component edge with one deduplicated quotient edge. Order components by the earliest source ordinal and then identifier. Define Φ on a dependency-closed atom set by returning exactly the SCC identifiers wholly contained in it; define Union by expanding quotient identifiers to their member atoms. Enumerate every downward-closed quotient subset because D has at most 16 nodes, expand it with Union, and verify exact correspondence by checking closure, round-trip identifiers, canonical materialized-artifact digests, and executor dependency resolution. Treat Δ_D(T) and Δ_G(Union(T)) as the same ledger lookup only after both names resolve to the identical materialized atom set and digest; otherwise abstain. Emit D, membership and inverse maps, the verification ledger, and `granularity_out_of_scope` when D exceeds 16 nodes.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Run Tarjan's algorithm on dependency graph G to find Strongly Connected Components (SCCs), meaning groups whose procedures depend on one another in a cycle. Give each SCC a stable identifier from its sorted atom identifiers, replace each dependency between two groups by one edge, and call the resulting graph D. Map any dependency-closed atom subset to the SCCs it fully contains with Φ, and expand SCC identifiers back to atoms with Union. Since D may have no more than 16 nodes, enumerate every downward-closed subset and check that mapping to atoms and back preserves identifiers, dependency closure, the materialized artifact digest, and executor resolution. Recognize Δ_D(T) and Δ_G(Union(T)) as the same measured effect only when both resolve to the identical atom set and artifact digest. Return all maps and checks, or `granularity_out_of_scope` when D has more than 16 nodes.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在依赖图 G 上运行 Tarjan 算法，求出强连通分量(Strongly Connected Component, SCC)，也就是彼此形成循环依赖的一组过程。用分量内排好序的原子标识生成稳定的 SCC 标识，把分量之间的重复依赖合并成一条边，得到商图 D。对任意依赖闭合的原子子集，Φ 返回其中完整包含的 SCC 标识；Union 则把 SCC 标识展开回原子。由于 D 最多含 16 个节点，枚举全部向下闭合子集，逐一检查展开再映射后标识不变、依赖仍闭合、物化产物摘要一致且执行器能解析全部依赖。只有两种表示解析为完全相同的原子集合和产物摘要时，才把 Δ_D(T) 与 Δ_G(Union(T)) 视为同一测量结果；否则弃权。最终输出 D、成员映射、逆映射与验证账本；节点超过 16 个时返回 `granularity_out_of_scope`。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Let N be the number of SCC nodes in verified quotient D and set Q to the preregistered maximum of 24 candidate-and-neighbor tests. Compile a canonical candidate predicate that accepts a sorted SCC-identifier set only if it is nonempty, omits at least one SCC from F, is downward closed in D, expands to atoms whose digests and source spans remain valid, passes executor dependency resolution, and satisfies every static contract predicate. Register the final N test indices exclusively for one deletion neighbor per possible retained SCC and expose only the first Q−N indices to discovery. Store each index once in an append-only query ledger with purpose, hypothesis identifier, candidate digest, seed-block identifier, and status; refuse unregistered tests, index reuse, discovery after its slots are exhausted, or any run that would leave fewer than N untouched neighbor indices.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Let N be the number of SCC nodes in verified graph D and define Q as at most 24 registered candidate-and-neighbor tests. A candidate is valid only if its sorted SCC set is nonempty, leaves out at least one SCC from the complete artifact F, contains every prerequisite required by each retained SCC, expands to atoms with unchanged source records and digests, resolves in the executor, and passes every static contract check. Reserve the last N test indices only for the eventual deletion neighbors and allow discovery to use only the first Q−N indices. Give each index one append-only ledger row containing its purpose, hypothesis identifier, candidate digest, random-seed block, and status. Reject unregistered tests, reused indices, extra discovery tests, or any run that would consume an index reserved for a neighbor.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 令 N 为已验证商图 D 的 SCC 节点数，并把 Q 定义为最多 24 次已登记的候选与邻居检验。一个候选只有同时满足以下条件才有效：排好序的 SCC 集合非空；相对完整产物 F 至少删除一个 SCC；每个保留 SCC 的全部前置依赖也被保留；展开后的原子来源记录和摘要未变化；执行器能够解析；并通过全部静态契约检查。把最后 N 个检验序号只留给最终删除邻居，发现阶段只能使用前 Q−N 个序号。每个序号在只追加账本中恰好占一行，记录用途、假设标识、候选摘要、随机种子块和状态。未登记检验、序号复用、超额发现检验或占用邻居专用序号都应被拒绝。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Expose a reducer adapter with input `{candidate_registry_digest, prior_discovery_ledger, reducer_state_digest}` and output one canonical sorted SCC set T_q plus an optional reducer trace. Before invocation, allocate q, a fresh paired seed-block identifier, and its preassigned discovery error share in the sealed ledger, but reveal neither fresh branch outcomes nor scorer outputs. Validate T_q against the S7 predicate, hash the reducer name, version, configuration, state, input ledger, and output, and append the proposal before launching any T_q/F/B branch. Invalid, duplicate, late, or outcome-informed proposals consume their registered index and produce a rejected proposal row rather than a replacement query.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Call any frozen slice proposer through one adapter. Give it the candidate-registry digest, the already revealed discovery ledger, and its own frozen-state digest; require it to return one sorted SCC set T_q and, optionally, a trace. First register the query number, a fresh paired random-seed block, and a preassigned error share, but do not reveal the new T_q, F, or B outcomes or raw scorer results. Check T_q with the candidate predicate from S7, hash the proposer's name, version, settings, state, inputs, and output, and save the proposal before any branch runs. An invalid, duplicate, late, or outcome-informed proposal uses its registered test index and is recorded as rejected instead of being silently replaced.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 通过统一适配器调用任意冻结的切片提出器。输入包括候选登记表摘要、已经公开的发现账本和提出器自身的冻结状态摘要；输出必须是一个排好序的 SCC 集合 T_q，并可附带提出过程记录。调用前先登记查询序号、新的配对随机种子块和预先分配的错误率份额，但不得透露新的 T_q、F、B 分支结果或评分器原始输出。用 S7 的候选谓词检查 T_q，散列提出器名称、版本、设置、状态、输入和输出，并在任何分支运行前追加提案记录。无效、重复、迟到或使用了未揭示结果的提案都会占用其登记序号并记为拒绝，不能悄悄换一个候选。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For registered query q, execute T_q, F, and B on the same fresh `pair_id` rows with isolated state and the S2 ledger schema. At this defining step, compute the slice-to-full paired gap G_τ(T_q), its simultaneous confidence interval I_τ(T_q), and discovery margin M_τ(T_q), where the margin is positive only when the entire interval lies strictly inside the equivalence band of half-width ε. Allocate α_{D,q} with the preregistered predictable sequence and enforce the sealed α_F, α_D, and α_C family partition without outcome-dependent reallocation. Apply the frozen correction to every contract and guardrail predicate, using η_j as the declared tolerance for guardrail j. Append raw pair references, estimates, interval endpoints, margin, error allocations, predicate decisions, and correction metadata; retain T_q only when M_τ(T_q) is strictly positive and every corrected predicate passes.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For registered query q, run T_q, F, and B on the same new pair identifiers with isolated state and the ledger format from S2. This step first defines the paired slice-to-full effect gap G_τ(T_q), its simultaneous confidence interval I_τ(T_q), and the discovery margin M_τ(T_q); that margin is positive only when the whole interval is strictly inside the equivalence band whose half-width is ε. Assign the query's error share α_{D,q} by the preregistered predictable sequence and never move error shares between the full-artifact, discovery, and confirmation families after seeing results. Correct every contract and guardrail decision, using η_j as guardrail j's declared tolerance. Save the supporting pair rows, estimates, interval ends, margin, allocations, decisions, and correction details, and retain T_q only when M_τ(T_q) is strictly positive and all corrected checks pass.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对已登记查询 q，在同一批新的 `pair_id` 上隔离运行 T_q、F 和 B，并沿用 S2 的账本格式。此步骤首次定义切片相对完整产物的配对效应差 G_τ(T_q)、其同时置信区间 I_τ(T_q) 和发现裕量 M_τ(T_q)；只有整个区间严格落在半宽为 ε 的等效带内，裕量才为正。按预注册的可预测序列分配本次查询的错误率 α_{D,q}，看到结果后不得在完整产物、发现和确认三个检验族之间移动错误率。对每项契约和防护规则执行冻结的多重校正，并把 η_j 作为第 j 项防护规则的声明容差。保存支持该结论的配对行、估计值、区间端点、裕量、错误率分配、全部判定和校正元数据；仅当 M_τ(T_q) 严格为正且全部校正检查通过时保留 T_q。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Apply one frozen total ordering to the surviving discovery rows and persist the selected T_star together with the exact ledger snapshot and ordering key. 【author decision: choose whether the ordering prioritizes retained SCC count, discovery margin, or another criterion, and provide a total tie-break because this choice determines the neighbor family claimed to be irreducible.】 For every SCC c retained by T_star, construct its dependency-relative deletion neighbor by removing c and every retained SCC that transitively depends on c, yielding the largest downward-closed subset that excludes c; deduplicate identical subsets while retaining all originating c identifiers. Register and execute every resulting neighbor on its reserved index, apply the corrected effect, contract, and guardrail decisions, and require each origin c to map to a tested neighbor that fails at least one condition. Emit T_star, selection evidence, the complete origin-to-neighbor map, all decision rows, and an insufficiency abstention whenever any neighbor is missing, untestable, or not rejected.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Choose T_star from the surviving candidates with one frozen total ordering and save the exact discovery-ledger snapshot and ordering key used. 【author decision: state whether the ordering first prefers fewer retained SCCs, a larger discovery margin, or another criterion, and define a complete tie-break because the choice changes which neighbor family is called irreducible.】 For each SCC c kept in T_star, form its deletion neighbor by removing c and every kept SCC that depends on c through any path; this leaves the largest dependency-closed subset that excludes c. Merge duplicate neighbor subsets but keep the list of original c identifiers. Test every neighbor on its reserved index with the corrected effect, contract, and guardrail rules. Every retained c must point to a tested neighbor that fails at least one rule; otherwise return an insufficiency abstention. Save T_star, the selection evidence, the full origin-to-neighbor map, and all decisions.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 用一个冻结的全序规则从通过发现阶段的候选中选择 T_star，并保存当时完整的发现账本快照和排序键。【作者需决定：明确排序首先偏好更少的保留 SCC、更大的发现裕量还是其他准则，并给出覆盖所有并列情况的确定性次序；该选择会改变被声称为不可再删的邻居检验族。】对 T_star 中每个保留 SCC c，删除 c 以及所有经任意依赖路径依赖 c 的保留 SCC，得到排除 c 后最大的依赖闭合子集。相同邻居子集可以去重，但必须保留它对应的全部原始 c 标识。用预留序号检验每个邻居，执行校正后的效应、契约和防护规则判定。每个保留 c 都必须映射到一个已检验且至少违反一项条件的邻居，否则返回证据不足弃权。输出 T_star、选择证据、完整的原子到邻居映射和全部判定行。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Materialize a sealed confirmation hypothesis ledger H_C before reading untouched outcomes, with rows for F, B, T_star, every registered deletion neighbor, the permuted-margin control, and each frozen direct output from ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE. Normalize every compact output through the identical S4 atom compiler and S5–S7 validity checks. 【author decision: define a baseline-neutral normalization policy for outputs lacking exact provenance or executable-region records, and preregister whether a nonrepresentable output is rejected, counted as an abstention, or excluded by an applicability rule.】 Build the permuted control by applying the manifest-sealed permutation to candidate labels within each paired discovery block while preserving branch pairing, then lock its selected artifact before confirmation. On untouched pair identifiers, rerun every H_C row, apply the frozen confirmation correction, and admit a compact output only if F remains eligible, the output is strict and nonempty, its slice-to-full interval lies inside the equivalence band, all contract and guardrail predicates pass, and its complete registered deletion family is rejected. Emit Cert_τ with manifest, artifact, atom, ledger, and decision digests for a passing T_star; otherwise emit a reason-coded corrected rejection or abstention for every H_C row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Before reading untouched outcomes, create a sealed confirmation hypothesis ledger H_C with one row for F, B, T_star, every registered deletion neighbor, the permuted-margin control, and each frozen direct output from ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE. Send every compact output through the same atom compiler and dependency, source-validity, executor, and contract checks used for EffectSlice. 【author decision: define a method-neutral conversion for baseline outputs that lack exact source or executable-region records, and decide in advance whether an output that cannot be represented is rejected, counted as an abstention, or excluded by a stated applicability rule.】 Create the control by using the manifest's sealed permutation to shuffle candidate labels inside each paired discovery block without breaking branch pairs, and lock the resulting artifact before confirmation. Rerun every ledger row on untouched pair identifiers and use the frozen confirmation correction. Admit a compact output only when F is still eligible, the output is strict and nonempty, its slice-to-full interval is inside the equivalence band, every contract and guardrail passes, and every registered deletion neighbor is rejected. Return Cert_τ with all identifying digests for a passing T_star, or a reason-coded rejection or abstention for every ledger row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在读取未使用样本的结果之前，建立并封存确认假设账本 H_C，其中分别登记 F、B、T_star、全部已注册删除邻居、发现裕量置乱对照，以及 ClawTrace、Graph-of-Skills 和 SkillRAE 的每个冻结直接输出。所有紧凑产物都必须经过与 EffectSlice 相同的原子编译、依赖检查、来源有效性检查、执行器检查和契约检查。【作者需决定：为缺少精确来源或可执行区域记录的基线输出定义与方法无关的转换规则，并预先决定无法表示的输出是判为拒绝、计为弃权，还是按明确的适用性规则排除。】按照清单中封存的置乱映射，在每个配对发现块内打乱候选标签，但保持分支配对不变，并在确认前锁定对照产物。随后在从未使用的 `pair_id` 上重跑 H_C 的每一行，采用冻结的确认阶段校正规则。只有 F 仍具备资格、紧凑产物严格非空且小于 F、其切片相对完整产物区间落在等效带内、全部契约和防护规则通过，并且全部登记删除邻居都被拒绝时，才可准入。通过的 T_star 输出带全部标识摘要的 Cert_τ；其他每一行都输出带原因码的校正拒绝或弃权。

enriched_steps.what_changes: After completing development on exactly eight existing tasks, tag the source revision, hash every manifest and executable artifact, disable configuration writes, and accept only new paper-task pair manifests whose identifiers and source snapshots were absent from development. Register at least four such pairs before any outcomes are read. 【author decision: define the eligible paper-task population, selection or sampling rule, exclusions, and the outcome-independent reference procedure that labels an admitted slice false; otherwise held-out and false-admission rates are not reproducible.】 Run the unchanged S1–S11 pipeline once per pair and append one terminal row with eligibility, atomization, quotient size, candidate status, confirmation decision, abstention reason, and supporting digests. Report the correctly admitted compact-artifact rate, false-admission rate, and abstention rate over the full registered denominator, with separate counts for ineligible, ambiguous, more-than-16-node, empty, and insufficient-test cases; publish every pair-level reason code and never remove a registered pair after its terminal state is known.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: After development on exactly eight existing tasks, tag the source revision, hash every manifest and executable artifact, disable changes to settings, and accept only paper-task pair manifests whose identifiers and source snapshots did not appear during development. Register at least four new pairs before seeing any outcomes. 【author decision: define the eligible population of paper-task pairs, how pairs are selected or sampled, all exclusions, and an outcome-independent reference that decides whether an admitted slice is false; without these choices the held-out and false-admission rates cannot be reproduced.】 Run the unchanged S1–S11 pipeline once for each pair and append one final row containing eligibility, atomization result, quotient size, candidate status, confirmation decision, abstention reason, and evidence digests. Calculate correctly admitted compact-artifact, false-admission, and abstention rates over every registered pair, with separate counts for ineligible, ambiguous, more-than-16-node, empty, and insufficient-test cases. Publish all pair-level reason codes and never remove a pair after its result is known.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在恰好八个现有任务上完成开发后，为源码修订打标签，散列全部清单和可执行产物，禁止继续修改设置，并且只接收开发阶段从未出现过其标识和来源快照的论文—任务对清单。看到任何结果前，至少登记四个新论文—任务对。【作者需决定：明确合格论文—任务对的总体、选择或抽样规则、全部排除条件，以及不依赖本次结果的错误准入判定程序；否则留出评估率与错误准入率无法复现。】对每个新组合原样运行一次 S1–S11，并追加一条终态记录，包含资格判定、原子化结果、商图大小、候选状态、确认结论、弃权原因和证据摘要。以全部已登记组合为分母，报告正确准入紧凑产物率、错误准入率和弃权率，并分别统计不具资格、有歧义、节点超过 16、空候选和检验名额不足的情况。公开每个组合的原因码，终态一旦出现就不得删除该组合。
